description:
Find West Coast Swing dancers in the WSDC Points Registry by name or WSDC ID.

        Returns WSDC ID, country, primary role and current division for each match, most
        recently active dancers first. Use the WSDC ID with the other dancer tools.

limit.description: Maximum number of dancers to return
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Dancer name (any order, partial names OK, Latin or Cyrillic) or a WSDC ID
query.title: Query

name: search_dancers

first_points.description: Date of the dancer's first WSDC points
first_points.title: First Points

last_points.description: Date of the dancer's most recent WSDC points
last_points.title: Last Points

primary_division.description: Highest division the dancer may enter in the primary role
primary_division.title: Primary Division

primary_division_points.description: Points in that division, primary role
primary_division_points.title: Primary Division Points

secondary_role.description: Set only when the dancer also has points in the other role
secondary_role.title: Secondary Role

match_type.description: 'id', 'name' or 'fuzzy' (no exact name match, closest spellings)
match_type.title: Match Type

title: Search WSDC dancers
